Malamar

Dark Psychic

Kalos · Generation 6

Malamar is a Dark/Psychic-type Overturning Pokémon first found in Kalos (Generation 6). It stands 1.5 m tall and weighs 47 kg. It evolves from Inkay. Its highest base stat is Attack (92), with a base stat total of 482.
